description: A white AirPods charging case sits on the pink surface near a white charging cable, with both hands resting in front of it. The right hand reaches toward the cable end while the left hand moves in to grasp the AirPods case; both hands bring the case and connector together briefly as if plugging or unplugging, then the left hand slides the case down toward the foreground and releases it while the right hand pulls the cable back to the right.
